key_claims: DIA assesses Iran concentrated support on Afghan Shiite groups (Nasr, Niruh, Sepah, Hesb-e Allah) after mid-1983.
Iran briefly supplied arms to Sunni mujahedin, including Hekmatiyar's Hesb-e Islami, in 1980-82.
IRGC adviser numbers in Hazarajat increased, raising discipline and responsiveness to Tehran.
Iranian support runs counter to Soviet goals; Hazaras serve as a bargaining chip for Iran.
Iranian repression of Afghan refugees aims to balance relations with Kabul and Moscow.
